title: Prague Trolleybus Peak Fleet

gtfs._why: Same feed and service date as the Prague tram sheet: the first weekday on the 27 Sep network (28 Sep is a public holiday).

description: Lines 52, 58 and 59 as published on 29 Sep: network of Sunday 27 Sep 2026 (PID timetable of Tue 29 Sep), trolleybuses from the Friday 25 Sep afternoon peak. Lines 51 and 53 on the 2 Nov network (PID export of 2 Nov, timetable of Wed 4 Nov): from Mon 2 Nov they also run all trips of bus lines 131 and 176; trolleybuses from the PID live map of Tue 3 Nov.
_fit_core_why: The shared runfit prefers runs overlapping 15:30-16:30 by 30 min. Line 58's inbound 12-minute pattern starts at 16:20, so that window picked a 40-minute, 3-4 slot pattern fitted to only 4 departures (4.5 trips an hour instead of 5). The 16:00 reference hour of the shared rules is used instead; lines 52 and 59 give the same values either way.

52.label: 52 Na Knížecí – Jinonice
52.why: Not recorded: the records give no branch, and both branches run all week with the same low course numbers. Needs 5 by round trip; courses 1–5 in course order (14 min each way). Course 10, also logged, is surplus to both branches and is marked not needed.

52.label: 52 Na Knížecí – Waltrovka
52.why: Not recorded: a choice, as for the other branch. Needs 3 by round trip (9 min each way).

58.label: 58 Palmovka – Miškovice
58.why: Not recorded: the records give no branch. Needs 7 by round trip; courses 1–7 in course order.

58.label: 58 Palmovka – Čakovice
58.why: Not recorded: a choice, as for the other branch. Needs 7 by round trip; courses 8–14 (the courses that do not run at weekends).

51: From Mon 2 Nov 2026 line 51 also runs every trip of bus line 131 (PID permanent change "Posílení trolejbusů v Praze"): every 6 min in the peak instead of one trolleybus every 44–72 min. 8 trolleybuses by round trip. The trolleybuses are from the PID live map of Tue 3 Nov (no deployment record exists after 1 Nov). Seven of the eight ran 51 that afternoon. 534 (51/7) and 536 (51/8) did too, but the 52 card has them and stays as it is, so 513 (on 51 in the morning) takes the eighth place.
53: From Mon 2 Nov 2026 line 53 also runs every trip of bus line 176 (PID permanent change "Posílení trolejbusů v Praze"): every 7–8 min in the peak instead of one trolleybus every 53–83 min. 6 trolleybuses by round trip. The live map of Tue 3 Nov showed 53 poorly (58 of its 230 trips, 1–3 trolleybuses at a time) and eight SNG 12Ts on it during the day; six of them are on the 52 card, which stays as it is. So 53 keeps 512 (already on 53 in the game), takes 530 and 537 from the map, and three free SNG 12Ts seen on 51 and 52 that week (542, 543, 544, designed).
52: Line 52 has two branches from Na Knížecí, each every 8 min, together every 4 min on the shared section to Waltrovka. Each branch is its own Simutrans line. The records do not say which course runs which branch, so the split below is a choice sized by round trip (5 + 3 = 8; 9 recorded). Course 52/9 runs on other weekdays (24 and 29 Sep) but is not recorded on 25 Sep. The alternative, one line running Na Knížecí → Waltrovka → Na Knížecí → Jinonice → Na Knížecí, would need 9, the number recorded.
58: Line 58 has two branches from Palmovka, each every 12 min, together every 6 min to Čakovice. Each branch is its own Simutrans line. The records do not say which course runs which branch, so the split below is a choice sized by round trip (7 + 7 = 14, all 14 recorded). One line alternating the branches would need 13.
59: Airport line with bi-articulated 24 m trolleybuses, every 3 min at the peak. On 25 Sep courses 59/6 and 59/14 are not recorded (both are recorded on Tue 29 Sep). The 15 recorded courses cover the 14 needed by round trip, so no trolleybus is designed. 59/8 changed vehicle during the day (401 → 413).

observed_lines._why: Lines 51 and 53 changed on 2 Nov, so their 25 Sep records no longer apply and are dropped. There is no deployment record for them (seznam-autobusu.cz blocked), so they take the trolleybuses the PID live map showed on them on Tue 3 Nov, except the ones the published 52 card already has: 52 is not affected by the change and keeps its trolleybuses (owner, 2 Nov). The places left are filled first with the trolleybus each line already has in the game, then with free trolleybuses of the line's type seen in service on the trolleybus lines that week.
